scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.validate:release: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:release-fixture-collisions && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:release-synthesis-telemetry && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:process-recovery
scripts.deployment:post-build: pnpm run db:schema:check && pnpm run test:benchmark-rollout && pnpm run verify:benchmark-rollout && pnpm run validate:release && pnpm store prune
scripts.validate: pnpm run codegen:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run validate:dashboard-restart
scripts.build: pnpm run codegen && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
